name: moonshadowrev/mirrorgate
description: Configuration-only PHP reverse-proxy mirror for shared hosting: mirrors a remote origin on your own domain with host rewriting, caching, stale-if-error and optional WebSocket/gRPC/TCP/UDP daemon.

suggest.ext-zlib: Enables gzip decoding and recompression of responses and compressed cache bodies
suggest.ext-apcu: Faster rate limiting and concurrency counters than the file based driver
suggest.ext-intl: Native IDNA conversion for internationalized domain names (a pure PHP fallback is built in)

lint: find src public bin tools -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
for f in bin/*; do php -l "$f" || exit 1; done

scripts-descriptions.test:standalone: Run the same unit tests with the dependency-free runner (no vendor/ needed)
scripts-descriptions.e2e: Start demo origin plus mirror on local ports and assert behaviour with curl
scripts-descriptions.daemon-selftest: Unit and end-to-end checks of the TCP/UDP/WebSocket/gRPC daemon
scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan (level 8) over the application code
scripts-descriptions.lint: Syntax check every PHP file and verify the CLI-only guards of the entry scripts
scripts-descriptions.check: Run lint, static analysis and tests
